messages:
ops-bot: ALERT: notify-bridge paging failed (sev2) at 2026-03-17T04:15Z — incoming webhook to incidentbot returned 500 for route /webhook/notify. link: https://logs.redwood.example/6178901234 :rotating_light:

mira: did the on-call get paged?

jordan: I didn't get anything. checked incidentbot UI — delivery_count=0 for the batch from 04:15Z.

sam: looking at the webhook proxy logs -> 04:15:07 - POST /webhook/notify -> 403 from signer service. error: "signature verification failed".

karima: pagerflow shows the payload was marked auto_suppress=true due to a malformed header. suspect signing rotation landed while messages were queued.

mira: so automation suppressed pages because signing failed? that would explain why SMS fallback didn't kick.

sam: exact headers from the failing request (redacted):
```
X-Request-ID: 6178901234-abc
X-Signature: (missing)
Content-Type: application/json
```

curl we used to repro:
```
curl -v -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"alert":"notify-bridge"}' https://incidents.redwood/webhook/notify
```

ops-bot: Note: suppression flag was set by the webhook layer when signer returned 403. fallback rules require `auth_status == OK` to trigger SMS relay.

jordan: I'm oncall now — manually paging affected teams. /manual-pager --service notify-bridge --reason "signer 403 rotation". tagging eng-sre. @mira @sam

mira: thanks. I'm opening a hotfix to reload signing keys on the proxy and to add a short-circuit so failed-signing -> manual-fallback doesn't auto-suppress. small change: treat missing X-Signature as retryable rather than suppress.

sam: deploying hotfix to the proxy now (rolling restart, 3 nodes). will watch metrics. command: `kubectl rollout restart deploy/webhook-proxy -n prod`

karima: monitoring notify-bridge paging metric and incidentbot deliveries. setting an alert if delivery_count < 10/min for 10m.

ops-bot: Customer impact note: pages to on-call phone/SMS may have been suppressed between 04:15Z-04:28Z. Estimated impacted oncalls: 2 teams. no customer-facing outages reported yet.

jordan: manual pages sent at 04:20Z. awaiting automated deliveries to resume after proxy restart.

sam: hotfix rolled at 04:27Z, rollout completed by 04:28Z. replays queued; incidentbot delivery resumed at 04:29:13Z. sample success log: "delivered=16 to pager endpoints"

mira: good — confirming: last_delivery_time 04:29:13Z, backlog drained.

jordan: thanks all. I'll keep this open for 30m to verify no recurrence. creating retro ticket INC-2026-034 to track root cause (signing key rotation flow) and action items:
- make signer rotation atomic across proxy and incidentbot
- add test for missing X-Signature handling
- add retro runbook for manual fallback

mira: adding owner for each item.

ops-bot: incidentbot automation -> recovered. marking incident as mitigated but not resolved. will close after postmortem. :white_check_mark:

sam: postmortem draft created and linked to INC-2026-034.

jordan: closing timeline note at 04:50Z if no regression. :thumbsup:
